issue.title: Fix blank Record tab, drafting chrome, and draft playback footguns
issue.body:
## Summary

Critical post-merge fix for drafting/Record after the Record stack landed: blank Record tab (expo-audio / mount lifetime), Lovable chrome parity, mic session not releasing after stop, take playback stuck at 0:00, and related navigation/guard bugs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Opening a chapter / Record tab loads (no blank screen from unresolved audio modules or mount teardown)
- [ ] Bible verse tap selects verse and opens Record
- [ ] Tab order Bible → Resources → Record; drafting chrome matches Lovable for built states
- [ ] Stop recording releases mic; leaving after stop does not show Recording in progress
- [ ] Draft take play shows real duration and advancing time (source dock remains stub → #235)
- [ ] Unit tests for engines / Record / tab bar pass; Android device QA recorded on PR

## Out of scope

- Real source-audio fetch/playback (#235)
- Full Resources content (#188+)
- Kill-safe multi-segment pause remux epic work

## Links

Related: #49 (Record tab), #96 (waveform decision), #235 (source audio stub follow-up)
